statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has a known history of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The service is to correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying rhythm disturbances
The diagnoses are I34.0 and R00.2
The denial is based on coordination of benefits rules (reason code CO-22)
The service may be covered by another primary payer
The primary payer must be billed first
